newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Sept private construction eases 1.14 percent.
newsitem.headline: Greek Sept private construction eases 1.14 percent.

text.p: Greece's index of private construction activity, measured by the construction volume based on the number of building permits issued, slipped 1.14 percent year-on-year in September, the National Statistics Service (NSS) said in a statement.
"In September, construction volume based on the number of building permits nationwide reached 4.32 million cubic metres against 4.382 million in September 1995, a decrease of 1.4 percent," NSS said.
In the first nine months of the year, private construction activity was up 22 percent, with the rise more pronounced in the Attica region up 36.4 percent, it said.
